info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Logistics Shipments Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Status API enables users to track the current status of shipments within the logistics framework. This endpoint provides a comprehensive overview of shipment statuses, allowing logistics managers and operations teams to monitor progress, anticipate delays, and ensure timely deliveries. Typical consumers include supply chain professionals and logistics coordinators who require up-to-date information on shipment progress. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance visibility into shipment operations and improve overall efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of all shipments. It provides crucial information regarding each shipment's progress, including shipment locations and any delays experienced.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching the status of shipments. This body is expected to be in JSON format and should adhere to the defined schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the current shipment status is returned.

ListLogisticsShipmentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving the status of shipments.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the shipment status request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional context about the operation result.

audit.description: Audit information related to the shipment status operation.

ListLogisticsShipmentsStatusResponse_200.description: Response schema for the status of shipments operation. This schema contains information about the shipment's status and associated metadata.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the record was created automatically.

Audit.description: Audit information related to the shipment operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 suggests that no processing time was measured.
